{{Quote|I owe you debt. It took you to bring me back to the Force.''"<br>"''And you to firm my faith in the power of the dark side, Master Shryne.|Roan Shryne and Darth Vader|<ref name="Dark Lord" />}}
'''Roan Shryne''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and briefly avoided [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. He wielded a [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|I never wanted you to be found.|Jula Shryne, to her son|<ref name="Dark Lord" />}}
Roan was born on [[Weytta]] to [[Jen Shryne|Jen]] and [[Jula Shryne]]. Against Jula's will, Jen surrendered the child to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] when Roan was just over three years of age. This action resulted in Jula leaving Jen.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

===Life as a Jedi===
{{Quote|We're not interested in politics.''"<br>"''Neither were the Jedi."''<br>''"Why fight if you weren't bred for it?"''<br/>''"To serve what remains of the Republic.|Commander Salvo and Shryne|<ref name="Dark Lord" />}}
Roan first faced serious combat as the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Nat-Sem]] around [[48 BBY/Legends|48 BBY]]. During his early training at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], Roan demonstrated a talent for sensing [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in others and was encouraged to pursue a course that would have landed him in the Jedi [[Acquisition Division/Legends|Acquisition Division]]. When he attained the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], Roan was offered a position within the Division, which took [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children to the Jedi Temple, but he refused to do so because part of him was uncomfortable with taking children from their parents. Shryne came to be one of what many Jedi referred to as the "[[Old Guard]]," Jedi considered likely to be put on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. Shryne, however, never attained that status.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

Shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Roan went on the first of many missions to [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]], a world not far from his homeworld, Weytta. He sought to bring down the crime lord [[Cash Garrulan]]. Instead, Garrulan became a Jedi informant and developed something of a friendship with Roan.<ref name="Dark Lord" />
He infiltrated this [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world many more times over the course of the Clone Wars, fatefully returning there in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] to fight alongside Commander [[Salvo (clone trooper)|Salvo]] hours before the end of the Clone Wars and prior to the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].<ref name="Dark Lord" />

Roan was part of the [[Jedi assault team/Legends|Jedi strike team]] at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Roan witnessed the death of his former mentor Nat-Sem as well as [[Roan Shryne's first Padawan|his first Padawan]]. [[Roan Shryne's second Padawan|His second Padawan]] was killed in the [[Battle of Manari]] in 19.5 BBY. By the end of the Clone Wars, Roan had lost his faith in the Force and the Jedi High Council. A sarcastic and bitter man, his connection to the Force became weak, and he struggled to use even elementary powers, getting by on experience and skill alone.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

Roan fought in the [[Siege of Deko Neimoidia|Battle of Deko Neimoidia]] alongside the [[22nd Air Combat Wing]], including the [[Clone commando/Legends|Republic commandos]] of [[Ion Team]]. He earned the respect of Captain [[Climber (clone)|Climber]] through the course of battling [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] (CIS) enemies in various campaigns together. Roan Shryne was one of six Jedi who participated in the [[Battle of Murkhana (Clone Wars)|Battle of Murkhana]], part of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] in 19 BBY, while the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was searching for [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] following his "failed" abduction of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. In the midst of the battle, Shryne saved Captain Climber's life while they were performing reconnaissance of a key medcenter that was housing a targeted shield generator. Climber later returned the favor by deliberately misdirecting an ambush per Commander [[Salvo (clone trooper)|Salvo]]'s orders that would have otherwise killed Masters Roan Shryne and [[Bol Chatak]], and Padawan [[Olee Starstone]], thus sparing them from the initial onslaught of Order 66.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

===Order 66 and the Jedi Purge===
{{Quote|An explosion bright as a star. A forest world, intrepid defenders, escaping ships, and...you, I think, somehow at the center of it all. Skywalker, it won't matter if you find them. It won't matter if you find and kill every Jedi who survived Order Sixty-Six. I understand now...the Force will never die.|Roan Shryne's last words to Darth Vader on Kashyyyk|<ref name="Dark Lord" />}}
[[File:DarkLordJapaneseCoverArt.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Shryne [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|confronted]] Darth Vader on Kashyyyk.]]
The trio deliberately allowed themselves to be captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] when they were disguised as CIS mercenaries. However, they encountered the mysterious "[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Lord Vader]]" before they could leave Murkhana. In a [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]] instigated by Bol Chatak, Vader revealed his overwhelming strength, as he brought Chatak to her knees before decapitating her.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

Fortunately for Shryne and Starstone, Vader was distracted, and they escaped Imperial custody due to Shryne's use of a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on an unsuspecting clone trooper. Starstone argued that Vader had to be a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], but Shrine had his doubts. With assistance and a fair amount of deception by Cash Garrulan, the Jedi escaped Murkhana aboard a [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]].<ref name="Dark Lord" />

They eventually rendezvoused with the ''[[Drunk Dancer]]'', captained by Shryne's biological mother, Jula Shryne. Starstone, rather than Shryne, took the lead in gathering survivors of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Shryne gave up the Jedi way and joined the smuggler crew under his mother, discarding a lightsaber and his use of the Force in exchange for a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and his wits.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

Shryne tried to help the crew deliver Senator [[Fang Zar/Legends|Fang Zar]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to [[Sern Prime/Legends|Sern Prime]] as their first smuggling job together. However, Zar was slain by Vader, who also injured Jula with his saber throw. Seeing that amount of skill forced Shryne to concede that Starstone had been right; Vader was indeed a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="Dark Lord" />

Despite trying to embrace a new life and hide out as suggested by the Jedi Temple on his [[Jedi beacon transceiver]], Shryne's true Jedi nature could not be forever denied, especially in the process of watching Olee Starstone naively falling into the Emperor's traps before his eyes. During a point at the Imperial subjugation of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], Shryne suddenly re-engaged himself as a Jedi Knight, shortly after Darth Vader had landed on the scene via his [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle/Legends|''Theta''-class T-2c shuttle]], destroying [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] warriors and anything else in his path. Specifically, just prior to Shryne's arrival, Vader had dispatched defending Jedi Knights [[Siadem Forte]] and [[Iwo Kulka]] by beheading them simultaneously in one sweep, critically injured Padawan [[Klossi Anno]] and [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] members [[Jambe Lu]] and [[Nam Poorf]], and shortly engaged Olee Starstone afterwards.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

Intrepidly, Roan Shryne suddenly intervened on the scene, calling to his hand Forte's lightsaber from the balcony floor and decapitating Commander [[Appo/Legends|Appo]] right in front of Darth Vader, challenging the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] to a duel. By doing so he allowed the ''Dancer'' crew and the younger Jedi to escape. The fateful duel against Vader ended in Shryne being dealt mortal injuries from Force-charged wood planks, despite some ingenious defensive and offensive tactics and insights during the battle, and only after Vader used [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force Throw]] to hurl objects at Shryne from all directions, which quickly overwhelmed Shryne's defenses. However, the Dark Lord did not kill him outright, but rather reveled in telling the dying Jedi of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] identity as a Sith; that he was the Sith apprentice of Lord Sidious; then finally, of his former identity as Anakin Skywalker. This, he believed, was the final insult to the dying Jedi, letting him know how utterly the Order had been destroyed from within.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

However, Roan still died happy, sarcastically thanking Vader for causing him to become one again with the Force. In the moments before his death, he recalled a Force vision he had experienced which, although it predicted the circumstances of his death, gave him peace in knowing that the Force would never die.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

As more Jedi were exterminated across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the newly anointed Galactic Emperor Palpatine ordered his [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] to cover up the reasons for the Jedi's death. Pestage compiled a [[Casualty Report: Order 66|list of official records]] to fabricate the Jedi's reasons for death. Shryne's report, reported by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bow (clone stormtrooper)|Bow]], stated that the Jedi Knight was executed for repeatedly disrupting Imperial recruitment efforts on Kashyyyk.<ref name="Order 66: Destroy All Jedi">{{InsiderCite|87|Order 66: Destroy All Jedi}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I see that you've abandoned your lightsaber."''<br>''"But not my commitment to justice. You know how it is, Vader. Once a good guy, always a good guy. Then again, you probably don't know anything about that."''<br/>''"Don't be too sure of yourself.|Darth Vader and Shryne, on Alderaan|<ref name="Dark Lord" />}}
Roan Shryne was known for having a rather bitter, pessimistic personality, possibly because he lost two Padawans before Order 66. He also had a tendency to be sarcastic at times. Despite this, Shryne's heart was in the right place, and he sacrificed his life to help the other Jedi escape from Darth Vader. He possessed a strong spirit and drive, something which even Darth Vader respected (going so far to say that he would find an apprentice with the same spirit Shryne had).<ref name="Dark Lord" />

Shryne was close friends with Climber, so close that the clone refused to execute him when he received Order 66. He also cared a great deal about Olee Starstone, even though she was not his Padawan, and was determined not to allow her to die, as his last two Padawans had. Shryne was also fond of Bol Chatak and felt sorrow when she was killed.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Who do you think you inherited your abilities from?"''<br>''"Awareness does not always run in families. But I sensed the Force in you the moment you entered the cabin.|Jula and Roan Shryne|<ref name="Dark Lord" />}}
Roan Shryne was well trained in lightsaber combat, able to hold his own against Darth Vader for a lengthy period of time, even though he was wielding an unfamiliar lightsaber. He landed two blows on the Sith Lord before being defeated&mdash;not through lightsaber prowess, but through Vader's superior command of the Force.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

As time went on, Shryne's connection to the Force weakened, and he struggled to use even simple Force powers, getting by on experience and skill alone. Gradually his Force connection returned and when he faced Vader for the final time, Olee Starstone knew he was a Jedi once more. Just before he died, Shryne had a vision of the future, foreseeing the Battle of Endor, which would take place over two decades later. He was also reasonably skilled with mind tricks, having successfully utilized one against a clone trooper.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RoanShryne-Hasbro.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Roan Shryne in action figure form]]
In [[2013]], [[Hasbro]] revealed that Shryne would be coming in an action figure multipack along with fellow Jedi [[Sarrissa Jeng/Legends|Sarrissa Jeng]] and [[Sephjet Josall/Legends|Sephjet Josall]], as well as [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] [[Ponds/Legends|Ponds]]. Though Shryne wields a blue lightsaber, the figure appears to come with a green blade. He was played by an uncredited extra.
